missions.text: Get {name} to say the word "pineapple."
Get {name} to say the word "submarine."
Get {name} to say "I don't know" three times in one conversation.
Get {name} to say the name of a planet.
Get {name} to say the word "seriously."
Get {name} to say any number bigger than one hundred.
Get {name} to say the name of a dinosaur.
Get {name} to sing any line of any song.
Get {name} to say "bless you" or "gesundheit."
Get {name} to hand you a pen or pencil.
Get {name} to hand you something blue.
Get {name} to give you a thumbs-up.
Get {name} to hold something of yours for at least a minute.
Get {name} to give you a compliment.
Get {name} to answer: "What's your favorite cereal?"
Get {name} to tell you what they'd name a pet goldfish.
Get {name} to tell you their least favorite vegetable.
Get {name} to rate any movie out of ten.
Get {name} to tell you which superpower they'd pick.
Get {name} to answer a "would you rather" question.
Get {name} to tell you what time it is.
Get {name} to sit next to you for five minutes.
Get {name} to agree to a game of rock-paper-scissors.
Get {name} to walk somewhere with you.
Get {name} to laugh at a joke you tell.
Get {name} to look up at the sky.
Get {name} to draw something for you on paper.
Get {name} to tie or retie a shoelace.
Get {name} to guess a number you're thinking of.
